def: Sarepta (i.e. Tsarephath), a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
